Hi, sorry this is going to be long but I need to explain everything because I have already explained it to three different people on chat and every time the chat closes and I have to start again. On the 2nd I ordered a set of kitchen shelves and a lamp. The website said delivery in 3 to 5 working days. On the 4th I got an SMS saying the order was dispatched with tracking number PK-77120 and that it would arrive on the 7th. On the 7th nothing came. The tracking page said 'out for delivery' the whole day and then in the evening it changed to 'delivery attempted, customer not available', which is not true because I work from home and I was here all day, my neighbour was also home and nobody rang. On the 8th I called the courier and they said they don't have the parcel at the local depot and I should contact the seller. Your chat agent told me to wait 48 hours. I waited. On the 10th the tracking still said the same thing. The second agent said she would 'escalate' it and I would get an email in 24 hours. I never got an email. The lamp was a birthday present for my mother and her birthday has now passed. I'm not asking for anything crazy, I just want to know where my parcel actually is and when it will arrive, and if you can't find it then tell me honestly so I can decide what to do. Please don't send me another copy-paste reply about waiting 48 hours.

Hello. I'm writing about the refund for my order of a pair of headphones. Here is the whole story so you don't have to ask me again. I bought them on sale for 18,500 rupees. When they arrived the left side didn't work at all. I opened a return request in the app the same day, printed the label, and dropped the box at the courier office on the 3rd. I have the receipt with the drop-off time. The app showed 'return received at warehouse' on the 9th. Your refund policy page says refunds are processed within 5 to 7 working days after the item is received, so I expected the money by the 18th at the latest. It's now the 27th and there's nothing in my account. I checked with my bank twice and they say there is no pending credit from you. In the app the refund status just says 'processing' and has said that for over two weeks. I'm not angry with whoever reads this, I know it's probably not your fault, but this is a lot of money for me and I need to know when it will actually be returned. If something went wrong with the return, please tell me what it is. I can send photos of the receipt and the return label if that helps. Thank you.
